turns.text: Unit 12, respond to First National Bank Branch 217, report of an attempted forged-check transaction.

turns.speaker: WITNESS_1
turns.text: I am Priya Shah, the bank teller. A man tried to cash a check for two thousand four hundred dollars.

turns.speaker: WITNESS_1
turns.text: The signature did not match our records on file for the account holder.

turns.speaker: OFFICER
turns.text: Did he leave the building?

turns.speaker: WITNESS_1
turns.text: No, he is sitting in the lobby. He says it's his uncle's check.

turns.speaker: OFFICER
turns.text: Sir, can you tell me how you came into possession of this check?

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: My uncle gave it to me to cover rent. His name is on it.

turns.speaker: WITNESS_2
turns.text: I was driving past and saw the whole thing through my window.

turns.speaker: WITNESS_3
turns.text: I live across the street. I came out when I heard the noise.

turns.speaker: WITNESS_2
turns.text: It looked like the man in the red shirt threw the first punch.

turns.speaker: WITNESS_3
turns.text: Actually from my angle it looked like the other guy started it.

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: I did not forge anything.

turns.speaker: OFFICER
turns.text: What is your uncle's name and phone number?

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: I do not remember the number. He just told me to deposit it.

turns.speaker: WITNESS_1
turns.text: I called the account holder before flagging this. He said he never wrote this check and the checkbook was stolen two weeks ago.

turns.speaker: OFFICER
turns.text: Did you sign the back of this check yourself, sir?

turns.speaker: SUSPECT
turns.text: Yes, I endorsed it.

turns.speaker: OFFICER
turns.text: Based on the account holder's statement and your admission of endorsement, I have probable cause to detain you for forgery and uttering. Stand up and turn around please.
